integrity: The theorem has a self-contained digit-expansion proof. Exact finite diagnostics corroborate, but do not replace, the universal argument. Source coverage is qualified by a partly inaccessible survey and potentially unindexed literature.
limitations: Assumes nonnegative integer polynomial coefficients and degree at least two. Gives a lower density of exceptional square-map bases, not the exact total density or the density of individual basins. Other cycles remain unclassified. Historical priority and independent audit are unresolved.
title: Carry-free fixed-point collisions for polynomial digit-sum dynamics
